needed.evidence: A continuous line of parked cars occupies the edge of the carriageway, leaving no separate paved or informal path for pedestrians to walk safely.
needed.suggestion: Construct a paved sidewalk on the left side to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians separate from the parked vehicles.

needed.evidence: Pedestrians are walking directly on the asphalt next to the parked cars, as there is no physical separation or sidewalk on the right edge.
needed.suggestion: Provide a pedestrian walkway on the right side of the road to remove the need for people to walk in the traffic area.

needed.evidence: Pedestrians, including children, are crossing the road between parked cars without any marked crossing, signals, or refuge island to protect them.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing with a refuge island to provide a safe point for people to cross the road.
